items.w: כאיל תערג על אפיקי מים כן נפשי תערג אליך אלהים
items.title: YEARNING
items.quote: As the deer cries out for springs of water, so my soul cries out for You, O G-d.
items.text: Visualize the life-giving flow of fresh water to enhance your spiritual experience of bonding with Hashem.

items.quote: My soul thirsts for G-d, for the living G-d.

items.w: היתה לי דמעתי לחם יומם ולילה
items.text: My tears have been [my] bread, day and by night.” Ask Hashem to let the bitter experience of being taunted by wicked people serve as a penance for your sins
items.title: TEARS

items.w: כי אעבר בסך אדדם עד בית אלהים
items.title: PAINFUL MEMORY
items.quote: how I used to pass along in the [stately] throng, proceeding slowly to the House of G-d.
items.text: Develop your yearning for the Geulah by visualizing the spectacle of the orderly procession through the gates of Yerushalayim in ancient times.

items.w: מה תשתוחחי נפשי ותהמי עלי הוחילי לאלהים
items.title: COMFORT
items.quote: Why are you downcast, my soul, and confused within me? Wait and look to G-d!
items.text: Work on yourself to restore your optimism and have faith that the Geulah will surely come.

items.quote: All Your breakers and Your waves have swept over me.
